query:
SELECT COUNT(s.created_at) AS "count!"
        FROM unnest($2::BIGINT[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS w(win, ord)
        LEFT JOIN admission_send_record s
            ON s.endpoint_bucket = $1
            AND s.created_at >= now() - w.win * INTERVAL '1 second'
        GROUP BY w.ord
        ORDER BY w.ord
